column3: “With a stylus of a man” is rendered “in ordinary letters,” and the name Maher-shalal-hash-baz is translated as “Swift is the booty, speedy is the prey.”
“Be bad” is rendered “Be broken,” and NASB adds “yet.”
“According to the strength of the hand” is rendered “with mighty power.”
“Instruction” is rendered “the law,” and NASB adds “it is because.”
NASB supplies “the land,” and “turn upward” becomes “as they face upward.”
